## HIGH IMPACT

No high-impact breaking changes are present in this release. No CSS custom properties were renamed or removed, no web component element names changed, no shadow DOM slots or parts were restructured in ways that directly break existing ha-lcars card-mod selectors.

## MEDIUM IMPACT

### Component: `hui-entity-card` (`src/panels/lovelace/cards/hui-entity-card.ts`)

**What changed:** `hui-entity-card` now injects a `--state-color` CSS custom property directly on the card's host element via `styleMap({ "--state-color": color })` when the card has a colored state active. The color is derived from `_computeColor(stateObj)` and applied inline, meaning it can override or interact with any theme-level or card-mod-level color assignments that target the card host.

**What it affects in ha-lcars:** The theme's `card-mod-card-yaml` (the `&card-mod-card` block) sets `--md-sys-color-primary`, `--lcars-primary-text`, `--card-primary-color`, and `color` on `:host`. Button-class cards (`.button-small`, `.button-lozenge-*`, etc.) set `background-color` on `> ha-card` and via `&:is(ha-card)`. None of these rules currently consume or suppress `--state-color`, so the new variable will propagate into any HA internal component inside the card that reads `--state-color` (e.g., state icons, badges, ripples). On LCARS button-class cards with fixed colors this may produce unexpected icon or indicator tinting that conflicts with `--lcars-card-button-color` / `--lcars-card-button-text`.

**Suggested fix:** In the `card-mod-card-yaml` common card block, explicitly suppress `--state-color` on button-class cards to prevent HA's new inline style from leaking into LCARS-controlled coloring:

```css
:host(.button-small),
:host(.button-large),
:host(.button-lozenge-left), /* ... all button classes ... */ {
  --state-color: var(--lcars-card-button-color) !important;
}
```

Alternatively, accept the new tinting as an enhancement (it only fires when `colored` is truthy, i.e., when the entity has a color-producing state), but be aware it will change icon/badge appearance inside those cards.

---

### Component: `hui-grid-section` (`src/panels/lovelace/sections/hui-grid-section.ts`)

**What changed:** Hidden cards (cards where `card-visibility-changed` fires with `hidden: true`) now receive the CSS class `hidden` on their `.card` wrapper div when `!editMode`. This is the fix for "Hide hidden cards in grid sections without `:has()`". The `.card` div (inside `hui-grid-section`'s shadow DOM) gains `hidden` class dynamically.

**What it affects in ha-lcars:** The LCARS theme does not currently target `.card` elements inside `hui-grid-section` directly, so no existing card-mod rules break. However, if any LCARS layout relies on all grid section card slots being visible/present for column/row counting or for LCARS frame continuity (e.g., a header/middle/footer triple that spans a grid row), cards that are now hidden will collapse from the layout entirely. Previously they may have rendered as empty space; now they are gone.

**Suggested fix:** No immediate CSS fix needed, but verify that LCARS multi-card frame layouts (header/middle/footer stacks in grid sections) still render correctly when one card in a row is hidden. If frames break, ensure the hidden card's `card-mod` sets `display: none` explicitly, or restructure layouts to avoid hidden cards within LCARS frames.

---

### Component: `hui-map-overview` / `hui-map-card` (`src/panels/lovelace/cards/map/hui-map-overview.ts`)

**What changed:** The map overview bottom sheet component was changed from `ha-resizable-bottom-sheet` to `ha-snap-bottom-sheet`. Additionally, the "more info" button in the map overview was replaced with a settings/cog icon button (`mdiCogOutline`), and a new `ha-icon-button` was added. The bottom sheet now snaps to fixed positions rather than being freely resizable.

**What it affects in ha-lcars:** The theme does not appear to have any card-mod rules targeting `ha-resizable-bottom-sheet`, `ha-snap-bottom-sheet`, or the map overview's internal structure directly. However, if any LCARS theme user has custom card-mod on `hui-map-card` that targets the bottom sheet or the more-info button, those selectors will silently stop working. The snap behavior also changes the sizing geometry of the overlay, which may affect how map cards render within LCARS panel views (`hui-panel-view` rules in `card-mod-root-yaml`).

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed in base theme. Document for users that any local card-mod targeting `ha-resizable-bottom-sheet` within map cards must be updated to `ha-snap-bottom-sheet`.

---

## LOW IMPACT

### Component: `ha-icon-button` (`src/components/ha-icon-button.ts`)

**What changed:** The `label` property of `ha-icon-button` is now passed as a property to the inner `ha-button` element rather than set as an `aria-label` attribute directly on the `ha-button` host. The comment clarifies this prevents screen readers from announcing the host as a named group. The rendered visual output and the button's tooltip behavior are unchanged.

**What it affects in ha-lcars:** The theme targets `ha-icon-button` in several places:
- `div.header .toolbar ha-icon-button` in `card-mod-root-yaml` (toolbar mobile layout rules)
- `div.menu ha-icon-button` in `card-mod-sidebar-yaml` (sidebar toggle button positioning)

Neither of these rules relies on the `aria-label`/`label` attribute binding mechanism. All selectors target the `ha-icon-button` element itself and apply layout properties (`margin-top`, `margin-right`, `z-index`). No fix needed.

---

### Component: `hui-history-graph-card` (`src/panels/lovelace/cards/hui-history-graph-card.ts`)

**What changed:** The `?inside-labels` boolean attribute was removed from the `state-history-chart-timeline` element rendered inside `hui-history-graph-card`. This restores left-column timeline names on the history graph card.

**What it affects in ha-lcars:** The theme has no card-mod rules targeting `state-history-chart-timeline` or the `inside-labels` attribute. The visual change (timeline names restored to left column, aligned X axis) may slightly alter the appearance of history graph cards within LCARS frames, but since the theme does not style the interior of the chart component, no rules break. No fix needed.

---

### Component: `hui-image` (`src/panels/lovelace/components/hui-image.ts`)

**What changed:** `hui-image` now detects streaming media via `isStreamingMedia()` and releases the image source when the element is detached (disconnected from DOM). The `live` directive is used on the image `src`. This is a memory/resource management fix with no structural DOM changes.

**What it affects in ha-lcars:** No card-mod rules in the theme target `hui-image` internals. No fix needed.
